listing.title: WisprStudio
listing.shortDescription: Offline-first voice studio for authorized cloning, dubbing, transcription and narration.
listing.description: WisprStudio is an offline-first desktop voice studio for consent-verified voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, transcription and narration. Audio, consent ledgers and projects remain on your computer with zero telemetry and no cloud account required. Models and runtimes install only through explicit user-initiated actions.

minimumOs.linux: Distribution supported by the selected package format

permissions.microphone: Record reference speech and provide real-time dictation when the user starts those features.
permissions.accessibility: Insert user-requested dictation into the focused application when the user enables this integration.
permissions.files: Open user-selected media and save generated audio, video and project files.
